name: Management of Risk Foundation
name_ja: リスクマネジメント (M_o_R) ファウンデーション

logistics.format: Computer-based multiple-choice exam (online proctored or testing centre)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 2, introductory: 1. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: A recognized risk framework provides a useful entry governance baseline, but the no-experience, knowledge-only format and limited regional recognition prevent an applied practitioner placement.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recognized risk framework and accessible one-hour exam establish foundational risk vocabulary. Regional recognition and nontechnical multiple-choice assessment provide little direct filtering value for operational security roles.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded risk-framework introduction requires no experience and uses a short multiple-choice exam. UK recognition makes it useful advisory literacy, without establishing technical security practice.
